description: Fetch the full GeoNames record for one geonameId: coordinates, feature type, the admin chain with each level's code, name, and geonameId, timezone, bounding box, recorded and DEM elevation, population, Wikipedia URL, names in other languages, postal codes, and external identifiers (IATA, ICAO, UN/LOCODE, Wikidata). Take the geonameId from geonames_search_places, geonames_reverse_geocode, geonames_get_children, or geonames_get_countries. An unknown id returns found: false. Costs 1 GeoNames credit; repeat lookups are cached.

geonameId.description: GeoNames feature id, a positive integer up to 2147483647 such as 5809844 (Seattle), as returned in geonameId by the other geonames tools. A geonames.org/<id> URL is reduced to its id.

geonamesUsername.description: Your own GeoNames username, so the call spends that account's free credits instead of the server's. Omit it to use the server's account. The account needs free web services enabled on its geonames.org account page.

nameLanguages.description: Keep only alternate names in these languages, up to 20, as a list or a comma-separated string. Case-insensitive; a tag also matches its regional forms (zh matches zh, zh-CN, and zh-TW). Omit to return every alternate name, including those under GeoNames pseudo-language tags (abbr, phon, piny, fr_1793), which this filter cannot select. Postal codes, links, and identifiers are unaffected.

items.description: Language tag or prefix, such as en, de, or zh-tw.

name: geonames_get_place

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `username_required`: Neither geonamesUsername nor the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME supplies a GeoNames account. `caller_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the caller-supplied geonamesUsername (unknown user, or free web services not enabled). `server_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME. `quota_exhausted`: GeoNames reported the account's hourly, daily, or weekly credit limit spent, or this server's pacer for the account shed the call. `upstream_rejected_parameter`: GeoNames rejected a value the schema let through; the message carries its text. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: False when GeoNames has no feature with this geonameId.

guidance.description: What to do next; present only when found is false.

place.description: The full record; absent when found is false.

adminLevels.description: Admin divisions containing the place, first level first.

items.description: One admin division containing the place.

geonameId.description: The division's geonameId, where GeoNames gives one.

alternateNames.description: Names in other languages and forms, filtered by nameLanguages when given.

isPreferredName.description: True when GeoNames marks this the preferred name in its language.

isShortName.description: True when GeoNames marks this a short name.

lang.description: ISO 639 language tag, or a GeoNames pseudo-language: abbr abbreviation, phon phonetic, piny pinyin, fr_1793 French Revolution name. Absent when untagged.

asciiName.description: The name in plain ASCII characters.

boundingBox.description: Bounding box of the feature. Absent for most points.

continentCode.description: Continent code: AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, or SA.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the containing country.

countryGeonameId.description: The containing country's geonameId, for geonames_get_children or geonames_get_place.

demElevationInMeters.description: Elevation from the SRTM3 digital elevation model, in metres.

elevationInMeters.description: Recorded elevation in metres. Often absent.

featureClass.description: One-letter feature class (P populated place, A admin division, …).

featureCode.description: Feature code, such as PPLC (capital) or ADM1 (first-order division).

featureName.description: GeoNames' name for the feature code.

type.description: Identifier scheme: iata airport, icao airport, faac FAA airport, tcid Transport Canada airport, unlc UN/LOCODE, wkdt Wikidata.

iso3166_2.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the first-order admin division, subdivision part only: MO, not US-MO.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

links.description: Web pages GeoNames links to the place, as received.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

name.description: Name of the place, as GeoNames displays it.

population.description: Population. Absent when GeoNames records none.

postalCodes.description: Postal codes GeoNames links to the place.

timezone.description: Timezone of the place. Absent when GeoNames sends none.

dstOffsetInHours.description: UTC offset in hours on 1 July.

gmtOffsetInHours.description: UTC offset in hours on 1 January.

timezoneId.description: IANA timezone id, such as Europe/Paris.

toponymName.description: GeoNames' main name for the feature, often the local-language form.

wikipediaUrl.description: English Wikipedia article, as GeoNames sends it (without a scheme).

title: Get a GeoNames place
